witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then checks: every job scheduled exactly once on a known machine, end-start == proc == jobs.csv proc_min (setup_min must NOT be used as duration), precedence J1 end <= J3 start, no same-machine interval overlap, reported makespan equals max end and the enumeration reference optimum (tolerance 1e-6).

correct.description: Correct big-M disjunctive MIP using proc_min, precedence J1 -> J3, no-overlap on both machines.

c_m1.description: Precedence is reversed (J3 before J1). Optimal makespan stays 17 by time-reversal symmetry, so the error is only observable as a schedule violating J1 end <= J3 start.

c_m2.description: No-overlap (disjunctive) constraints are only generated for M1; machine M2 gets overlapping jobs and the makespan drops to 11 < 17.

c_m3.description: Column mapping error: setup_min is used as the processing duration instead of proc_min, giving makespan 20 != 17.

c_e1.description: Equivalent rewrite: combinations-based pair loops, <=-form disjunctive constraints, different variable naming; same feasible set and optimum.
